verdict.rationale: Crossmint's agent-commerce docs describe completing checkout given a merchant URL and spending cap (crossmint-docs-15, crossmint-supp-7) and creating order intents with amount/expiration, but there is no evidence of a machine-readable offer/catalog API exposing price, availability, variants, or checkout links for listed products prior to purchase — the polling model even lacks structured state until a terminal status. Missing for 10: any documented offer/catalog read endpoint, variant/availability schema, or discovery API distinct from the checkout-execution flow.
